owner_asks.content:
Answering the two questions above from the site's own daily closes (2011-07-17 to 2026-11-16), entry S days before the halving, exit S days after:
400 days: median 12.85x, worst 3.96x, 4/4 windows underwater first, worst low -27.2%
500 days: median 20.78x, worst 6.60x, worst low -83.7%
600 days: median 7.49x, worst 4.55x, median low -49.6% (3 windows only, our archive starts July 2011)
So the number matters, the direction does not: every completed window in every spacing closed above its entry. 400 is shallower because October 2011 was near the bottom, not because 400 is safer.
One correction: the tracked record is $50,000 paper, not $10,000 as in the opening post. Live ledger, daily from 29 Nov: https://btc500.net/paper-buy
